plan.title: Closed RFQ Recreate Order Numeric Validation

steps.note: Open the API-prepared closed RFQ with Vendor A's bid, as required for prepared-state cases.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the test configuration.
Ensure post-expiry surrogate bidding is disabled.
Enable buyer editing of bid fields as required.
Apply the required evaluation permission configuration.
Reach the Responses view containing the bid and stage Settings action.
Open the Recreate Order window from the RFQ stage Settings menu.
Assert that the Recreate Order window opened.
Attempt to set the event-end duration to zero using the available duration control.
Enter the negative evaluation duration from the case.
Set the requested future delivery date.
Assert that Create Order is refused because the numeric durations are invalid.
